seo.title: What is llms.txt?
seo.description: llms.txt is a plain text file at the root of a website that describes the site and points to its most useful pages for AI assistants.

definition: llms.txt is a plain text file at the root of a website that describes the site and points to its most useful pages for AI assistants.
answerBlock: llms.txt is a plain text file at the root of a website that describes the site and points to its most useful pages for AI assistants. It is a proposed convention rather than a standard anyone enforces. It costs almost nothing to publish and gives an assistant a curated map instead of a guess.

body.heading: What goes in an llms.txt file?
paragraphs: A short description of the company, what it does and where it works, then a list of the pages that answer the questions people actually ask: services, pricing, process, locations, the glossary and the guides.
It is not a substitute for accessible HTML. An assistant that follows the file still reads the pages, so the pages still need to open with a direct answer and state specifics in plain text.

It sits alongside robots.txt, which decides who may crawl at all. Permitting the major AI crawlers is a deliberate business decision: it means accepting that your content will be summarised, in exchange for being the source that gets named.

commercial.heading: Why does it matter commercially?
paragraphs: Being cited by an assistant is becoming a first impression in its own right. A file that costs an hour to write and maintain is a cheap way to influence which of your pages that impression is built from.
The measurable version of the question is simple: ask the assistants your buyers use, and see whether you are named.

example.heading: What does it look like in practice?
example.body: Our own file names the services, the pricing page, the process page and this glossary, so an assistant asked about B2B website costs is pointed at the page that states a band rather than at a blog post.

service.title: AI search visibility
service.line: Technical SEO plus the newer work of being cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and AI overviews.

terms.definition: Answer engine optimisation is the work of getting a company cited in the answers that AI assistants write, rather than only ranked in a list of blue links.
A canonical tag tells search engines which address is the official one for a page that can be reached at several addresses.
Core Web Vitals are three measurements Google publishes to describe how a page feels to the people using it: loading, responsiveness and visual stability.
Structured data is machine-readable markup added to a page that states what it is about in a vocabulary search engines understand.
